_meta.privacy: No cookies, no localStorage identifiers, no fingerprinting, no third-party requests, no cross-site tracking. Events are sent to the site owner's own endpoint and are never shared with Amazon or anyone else. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured by not sending anything.
_meta.why_disabled: No endpoint exists yet. GitHub Pages cannot host one (FLG-006). When an endpoint is chosen, set WINA_CONFIG.endpoint in assets/config.js and the same five events start flowing with no further code change.
_meta.pii_rule: No field in this schema may ever hold a name, email, IP address, precise location, or free-text input from a reader.

events.name: disclosure_view
events.fires_when: The disclosure strip first enters the viewport on any page.
events.why: Proves the material connection was actually on screen, not merely present in the DOM. This is the compliance-evidence event.

events.name: product_view
events.fires_when: A product page or product card becomes the primary item in view.
events.why: Tells you which of the five products people actually reach, independent of what they click.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: A click on any link carrying rel="sponsored" that resolves to amazon.com.
events.why: The outbound-click counter. This is the only click number this site can measure on its own; reported orders must come from Amazon.

events.name: compare_open
events.fires_when: A reader opens or expands a comparison table.
events.why: Distinguishes readers who are still deciding from readers who have decided. Useful for choosing the next guide topic.

events.name: guide_read_complete
events.fires_when: A reader scrolls past 90% of a guide's body.
events.why: The only honest signal that a guide was actually read rather than bounced off.

session_bucket.definition: A random 6-character value generated in memory per page load. It is not persisted and not stored in any cookie or storage API. It exists only to group events within one page view and cannot be joined across pages or across visits.
session_bucket.purpose: Prevents counting one reader's five scroll events as five readers.
